ov: About 220 species of flat, cartilaginous fish with a venomous barbed stinger on the tail. They are common in warm coastal seas worldwide, and some live in rivers.

why.dg: A sting is very painful but rarely fatal. Steve Irwin’s death in 2006 was only the second recorded in Australian waters since 1945.
why.et: Rays are edible, and stingray dishes are found on coasts worldwide.

rg: Tropical and subtropical coastal waters worldwide; river stingrays in fresh water.
fx: Stingrays give birth to live young, in litters of five to thirteen.

_cf.tip: Mantas belong to the same order as stingrays; they filter-feed on plankton.
